t1.text: The Quiet Admission — campaign landing template v2

n2.text:
v2 changes (7 Oct)
• Real Kairali logo + award logos
• CTA → 'Get free doctor consultation' (Gaurav) — must be a real doctor consult
• Step-1 form now inside first screen (ends at 773px on desktop)
• 'Ask anything' chat: bottom-right desktop, sticky bar on mobile
• Films section: property film + patient stories, click-to-play only
• Offer band + price block are Tweaks toggles (Gaurav: hide price; research: show — A/B test)
• Gallery: filter + lightbox
• Full footer; pages fit the 8,000px artboard limit
• 'Since 1908' removed pending 1908 vs 1989 decision
• Mobile: no side-scrolling anywhere — doctors and films stack vertically (40+ audience)

t2.text: Variants B · C · D — same content file, different design

n3.text:
Variant recipes (all share one campaign content file)

A · Quiet Admission — Night + ivory + bronze. Split hero, sensual. Flow: hero → bar → proof → offer → admission → stillness → films → doctors → village → fees → form → FAQ.

B · Garden Bento — warm cream + sage + terracotta, Instrument Serif + Plus Jakarta Sans. Floating pill nav, bento hero (photo tile + form card + rating/doctor tiles), double-bezel cards, pill CTAs. Flow: hero+form → proof → village FIRST → admission → doctors → films → fees → form → FAQ.

C · Editorial — cream + oxblood, magazine type, large portrait. Flow: hero → story → stillness → method → doctors → films → fees → form → FAQ.

D · Direct — soft white structure, bold Plus Jakarta Sans 800, dark form card as hero, proof bento, short (~5 sections). Flow: hero with step-1 form → proof → 3 reasons → fees → doctors strip → FAQ → footer. For brand, competitor and retargeting ads.

Test at ad level: /campaign/a|b|c|d (noindex).
